newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Packers have active live supplies and boxed beef under pressure.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Index down for latest two reporting days and corn futures called higher.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.100 to 0.250 cent. Cash hogs seen steady to lower and pork product values lower.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.250 to 0.500 cent. Carryover from limit losses, product weak and kills running above year ago.
